title: R-Type
build: tape version 1, cracked to disk by Oneway (R-TYPE++), level-skip key added

records.c: The stage file's entry table, at the same addresses in every stage: $6370 plays one frame of music and sound (called from the raster handler each frame), $6373 silences the SID (music_stop), $6376 asks for a sound effect (A the effect, X the voice), $6379 asks for a tune (A the tune), $637C points the driver at a block of music data (X low, Y high). The driver plays three voices, each stepping through a track of patterns, each note played through an instrument with pulse sweep, vibrato, slides and a shared filter sweep.
Entry 2: silence (jumps to music_stop).
Entry 3: ask for a sound effect, A the effect and X the voice (jumps to request_sound).
Entry 4: ask for a tune, A its number (jumps to request_tune); game_over asks for tune 1.
Entry 5: point the driver at a music data block (jumps to music_data).
The low nibble written to $D418 with the filter mode: the master volume.

Stage 8's boss, the heart of the Bydo empire, once a frame through the JSR at $57F7. Once it is beaten ($0249) its timers are reset and it stops. While the map still scrolls, its sprites move left a pixel every other frame, so it comes in with the scenery. Then, every frame: it hands the X of its first sprite to boss_hits ($77/$78), opens and closes its core (boss8_core), opens and closes the hatch on its right (boss8_hatch), animates the creature it throws (boss8_anim) and moves it (boss8_throw).
